title: Thera: The Inverted Planet
overview: On another world much like our own, a young Samoyed named Seamus Alessandro O'Shaughnessy discovers a lost girl named Dakota who has unfathomable magic! Seamus must overcome great challenges both physical & emotional alongside his best friend Carolina Oriqueda Campbell Keeshond-Seal to save Great Canyon City from the Menace known as The Blurred Blaze! Can our heroes defeat their foes while simultaneously protecting an innocent child in the process? And who exactly is The Blurred Blaze?

title: Wings of Freedom
overview: Home-loving eagle Salana is forced out of her jungle bird colony to join Pirro, an intrepid swift and member of the Animal Air Force. This unlikely duo embarks on an epic, high-flying adventure to stop a malevolent AI and save the world.

title: H24
overview: To avoid going to prison, Mélanie—an impulsive, outspoken young woman—is forced to train as a nursing assistant. The problem is, she faints at the slightest needle prick or drop of blood. After yet another blunder, she has no choice but to accept a job that’s completely unsuitable for her: providing round-the-clock care for a 65-year-old obsessive businessman who has just survived a stroke and can’t stand anyone invading his personal space. With these two together, their living arrangement promises to be explosive…

title: I Am Legend 2
overview: A sequel to the 2007 film. Plot TBA.

title: The Widowmaker
overview: Mechanical engineer Aiko Hoshino investigates the mysterious death of her brother, uncovering a deadly conspiracy surrounding an experimental system known as SHURA.

title: Sidi Kaba and the Gateway Home
overview: With the help of the goddess Mami Wata, Sidi Kaba, an 8‑year-old boy, tries to find his brother who has been taken prisoner by slave traders. A fantastic epic that delivers us along the road of slavery.

title: Demande à la montagne
overview: One sleepless night, Mathieu sets off into the mountains. He hikes as far and as high as he can, until he is utterly exhausted. The next day, Félix, a farmer, reports him missing to the police. Viviane, Mathieu's mother, arrives in the valley to expedite the search, but to no avail. Rumors begin to circulate, amplified by the local press. Distraught, Viviane tries to reach out to Félix, hoping to break the silence and isolation that have engulfed them both.

title: Justice Hearts: The Dark Empire
overview: The sequel to Justice Hearts but it's set in 2023 where Lewis is growing in the college years and balances his accept for being a demon hunter, but things go wrong when he goes into the Korean folklore with creatures from his 2 best allies.

title: The Spiral
overview: On a stormy night in Rome, Anna arrives at her daughter Alice’s apartment with a devastating confession: their entire family history is built on a lie. Twenty years earlier, after a horrific accident that nearly cost Alice her leg, Anna claims she made a pact with a mysterious Stranger to save her. But the miracle came at a price. What she believed was a single desperate bargain has in fact unleashed a spiraling chain reaction — a domino effect of increasingly dark events that have haunted their lives ever since. Now, the Stranger has come to collect. And Anna is convinced that only Alice can break the spiral and set things right. But at what cost?

title: The Summer I Turned Pretty: The Movie
overview: A continuation of the events following the end of the TV series 'The Summer I Turned Pretty."

title: The Legend of Zelda
overview: A live-action adaptation of Nintendo's Legend of Zelda video game series.

title: Layover
overview: A stranded Marine awaiting a flight home forges an unexpected bond with a marginalized stranger during one tense night in 1966.
